title: Design: Asset tab shows no Bill To column when every row bills itself
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new asset for this test whose work orders all bill their own customer.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p7-02-after-whole-history.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Work Orders tab has no Bill To column; Customer is followed by Asset.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R6: “A "Bill To" column shows when at least one row bills someone else; it is blank on self-billed rows.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "7 Asset Work Orders tab", pictures "Whole history" (This build).
